about_pullquote: I take pride in leaving every home looking better than I found it.
about_para_1: Callum Emslie has been decorating homes across Newcastle for over 15 years. Starting as an apprentice, he's built a reputation for meticulous preparation, colour advice, and attention to detail that shows in every finished room. From Victorian terraces to modern apartments, he's tackled every type of property and surface.
about_para_2: Customers return to Callum because he listens, delivers on time, and treats your home with respect. He carries all materials in his van, minimises disruption, and isn't afraid to suggest what will work best for your space — even if it's not what you originally asked for. That honesty and craftsmanship is why his phone keeps ringing.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Callum came highly recommended and he didn't disappoint. Did the whole downstairs in our Victorian terrace—skirting, dado rails, three colours. Work was immaculate, left the house spotless every day. Fair price and he's booked back for the upstairs. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: My kitchen was looking tired and I didn't know where to start. Callum suggested a couple of colours I'd never have picked, but honestly it's transformed the space. Professional, friendly, and he didn't rush. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Emma P.

reviews.text: Needed the exterior repainted before winter. Callum quoted fairly, started promptly, and finished when he said he would despite dodgy weather. Quality of work is excellent and he's tidy. Will definitely use him again.
reviews.author: James W.
